howto.what: Claude将按照经典TDD原则生成测试代码，仅验证状态结果，不验证交互调用；自动使用@Nested结构和Given/When/Then格式，并提供默认参数的工厂方法。
howto.when: 当你提到「테스트 작성」「test skeleton」等关键词，或要求编写测试、生成测试骨架、选择mock策略时触发。

say.note: Claude会生成符合规范的集成测试骨架。

say.text: 给这段代码加单元测试，使用BDD结构
帮我写一个工厂方法用于测试
say.note: 会创建带默认参数的私有工厂方法。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will generate test code following Classical TDD (state verification only). It uses @Nested BDD structure, Given/When/Then comments, and factory methods with default parameters. Avoids interaction verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "테스트 작성", "test skeleton", or request to write tests, generate test skeletons, or decide mock strategies.

say_en.text: Generate an integration test for OrderService.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a skeleton following project conventions.

say_en.text: Add a unit test with BDD structure for this code.
Create a factory method for testing.
say_en.note: Factory with all parameters defaulted will be created.
